summary.value: A willing NPC in your Sanctuary may extract and grant you their Soul Treasure — no forcing, no persuading.

system.description: A willing NPC in your Sanctuary may extract and grant you their Soul Treasure — no forcing, no persuading. While it is equipped or in your pack, you may Haunt them as though your Bond were strength 1, or your real Bond if higher. A Soul Treasure is that creature's hoplosphere.
